name: 13873-longprompt-glm46fp8-tp8
model: zai-org/GLM-4.6-FP8, pinned to checkpoint sha c064d336a8d0b0f59071f77eafdcdfca40f4b54c. Ungated. 361.3 GB of safetensors, 45.2 GB per card at TP8.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1 (expert parallelism off), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 3.0 req/s, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 500 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompts centred on 4096 tokens (stdev 1024, clamped 2048-8192), generations centred on 256 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 128-512), temperature 0.0, ignore_eos true, seed 42. ~94% of the tokens crossing the machine are prompt tokens.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long reports for analysts, three requests per second, short answers, eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang server arguments at commit f5f3a5d98c251353ee570ba171ac3c94cc928202
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.5.5.post3-404-gf5f3a5d98c2). Everything not written below is a
# stock default of this commit, deliberately. Nothing is tuned.
#
# host / port / served-model-name are set by whatever starts the server and waits for /health.

# 361.3 GB of safetensors over 93 shards, NOT in the local HF cache: it downloads once before the
# first run.
model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.6-FP8

tp-size: 8

# The checkpoint ships a custom chat template and tokenizer, and no python modules -- so this
# changes nothing about the model definition. It is set because a start failure without it costs a
# 361 GB load to discover.
trust-remote-code: true
